---
name: audience-test
description: Writing for test readers (about ages 8-12): length, language and what keeps them reading.
---

# Test

## Length
- TS-LEN-01: Total length 30,000-55,000 words. [S1]

## Language
- TS-LANG-01: Sentences average under 15 words. [S1]

## POV, tense and protagonist
- TS-POV-01: Protagonist is 10-13 years old. [S1]

## Content limits
- TS-CON-01: No on-page sexual content. [S1]

## Pacing and themes
- TS-PACE-01: Something changes in every scene. [S1]

## Reader psychology
- TS-ENG-01: Chapters end on an open question. [S1]

## Put-down risks
- TS-RISK-01: Long exposition before the inciting incident. [S1]

## Re-engagement
- TS-RE-01: After a quiet scene, the next opens mid-action. [S1]

## Sources
- [S1] Example source. https://example.org/a (accessed 2026-10-04)
